name: Chicken Thigh
siboNotes: Excellent protein choice for SIBO as it's naturally FODMAP-free and provides essential amino acids without feeding bacterial overgrowth.
preparationTips: Season with low-FODMAP herbs like oregano, thyme, or rosemary
Avoid garlic and onion powder - use garlic-infused oil instead
Cook with skin on for added flavor and healthy fats
Marinate in low-FODMAP ingredients like lemon juice and allowed spices
nutritionalHighlights: Good source of B vitamins, especially niacin
